svg.title: Those Called Gods
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 7 panels. Panel 1 (Exodus 7:1): Moses, grey-haired, holding his staff and looking up to a voice from above. Caption: "On earth, God lends the name to those He sends." The LORD says: "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh." Panel 2 (Exodus 22:9): three judges seated, two men standing before them with a dispute. Caption: "Israel’s judges give God’s verdict." The Law says: "The case of both parties shall come before God." Note: "Here ʾĕlōhîm takes a plural verb: the judges." Panel 3 (Psalm 82:1-7): a throne of light; before it a row of judges stand with heads bowed. Caption: "God has taken His place in the council and judges the “gods”." God says: "You are gods, sons of the Most High, all of you; nevertheless, like men you shall die." Note: "Who they are is contested: judges, heavenly powers, or Israel at Sinai. Drawn: judges." Panel 4 (Daniel 10:10-13): Daniel on his hands and knees by the river, a voice speaking to him from above. Caption: "Over the nations: princes in heaven." The man in linen says: "The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days, but Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me." Note: "The man in linen (10:5) is drawn as a voice." Panel 5 (1 Corinthians 10:20): a man offering at a stone idol on a plinth, smoke rising from the altar. Caption: "Behind the idols." Paul says: "What pagans sacrifice they offer to demons and not to God." Note: "“By nature are not gods” (Galatians 4:8)." Panel 6 (Colossians 2:15): three empty crosses on a rise at dusk. Caption: "At the cross." Paul says: "He disarmed the rulers and authorities and put them to open shame, by triumphing over them in him." Panel 7 (Hebrews 1:8): Jesus standing in radiant light, gold lines converging on Him, a voice speaking from above. Caption: "The one called God who is God." The Father says: "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever." The point: Every power that carries the name “god” was made through the Son, answers to God, and was disarmed at the cross. So fear none of them, and worship the Son, whose throne is forever (Colossians 2:15; Hebrews 1:8).
